_comment: App behaviour that isn't scoring. default_departure: "HH:MM" opens the app at that local time (good for night demos); null opens at the current time.
disclaimer: Scores reflect available data and can't guarantee safety. In an emergency call 112.

google._comment: Used only when GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY is set in backend/.env. Turn individual features off here.

gemini._comment: Gemini 2.5 models only (enforced in code; never 3.x or newer). GEMINI_MODEL in backend/.env overrides. Thinking off (budget 0): explanations are short and must be fast. With GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT set, Gemini runs on Vertex AI with Application Default Credentials; GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION overrides vertex_location.

trips._comment: Walking trips inside one supported city.

maps_grounding._comment: HerSide's ask_google_maps tool: Gemini on Vertex AI grounded with Google Maps (needs GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT + ADC). Billed per Maps query. Sources must be shown after the answer, attributed to 'Google Maps'.

assistant_scope._comment: HerSide answers personal-safety questions only. Every non-emergency message is classified first (Gemini, or Ollama when HerSide runs locally); out-of-scope messages are refused before any agent or tool runs. If the check fails, HerSide refuses rather than answering unchecked. Flash-Lite: 30/30 on the live test set, median 1.1 s.

allowed.walking_route: planning or comparing a walk: routes, timing, lighting, transit, weak stretches, Plan B
allowed.help_nearby: finding police, hospitals, pharmacies, washrooms, transit stops, or places open and staffed late
allowed.place_safety_context: safety-relevant facts about a place or area: open late, staffed, busy or deserted at night, lighting, crowds, how to get there or wait there
allowed.emergency_or_concern: feeling unsafe, being followed, harassment, distress, helplines
allowed.reporting_or_sharing: reporting a hazard or harassment, sharing live location, how SafeHer works
allowed.safety_guidance: general personal-safety guidance for walking or travelling in Delhi or Bengaluru

assistant_scope.refusal: I can only help with walking safety: planning a route, finding help or open places nearby, safety facts about a place, reporting something, or sharing your location. For immediate danger in India, call 112.
assistant_scope.check_failed: I couldn't check that question just now, so I won't answer it. Try again, or use the route planner and the Police, Hospitals and Open now buttons. For immediate danger in India, call 112.
